title: J003: Add Kubernetes E2E test with kind and DaemonSet
description:
**Size:** 🏗️ large
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** high
**Source:** Proposed for 'After binary builds, Docker image builds, etc. are now in place'

Create Kubernetes E2E test that validates all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests work on a real cluster. Build test/e2e/kubernetes/mock-api-manifests.yaml (Deployment + ClusterIP Service for mock-api). Create test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh orchestration script that: creates a kind cluster, builds and loads plexd + mock-api images into kind, applies all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests (namespace, RBAC, CRDs, serviceaccount, secret, configmap, DaemonSet), applies mock-api manifests, waits for DaemonSet rollout, port-forwards to mock-api, validates /test/assertions counters, then deletes the kind cluster on cleanup. Add Makefile target test-e2e-k8s.

**Rationale:** The Kubernetes DaemonSet deployment is the primary production deployment mode. Without E2E testing, RBAC misconfigurations, missing CRDs, incorrect serviceaccount references, or DaemonSet scheduling issues would only be caught in production. This validates the entire manifest stack end-to-end.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/kubernetes/mock-api-manifests.yaml
- test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh
- deploy/kubernetes/
- Makefile

stories.title: CI engineer validates Kubernetes manifests end-to-end
stories.want: an automated test that creates a kind cluster, applies all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests, and validates the DaemonSet reaches ready state
stories.so_that: RBAC misconfigurations, missing CRDs, incorrect serviceaccount references, or DaemonSet scheduling issues are caught before merging
criteria: Running 'make test-e2e-k8s' creates a kind cluster, loads images, applies manifests, validates, and tears down
The test applies all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests: namespace, CRDs, serviceaccount, RBAC, secret, configmap, and DaemonSet
The DaemonSet pod reaches Ready state within a configurable timeout (default 120s)
The kind cluster is deleted on both success and failure via a cleanup trap

stories.title: CI engineer verifies plexd registers and heartbeats against mock API in Kubernetes
stories.want: the Kubernetes E2E test to deploy the mock-api server as a ClusterIP Service and verify plexd's registration and heartbeat flows via /test/assertions counters
stories.so_that: the full plexd lifecycle (register, heartbeat, state fetch) is validated in a real Kubernetes environment
criteria: Mock-api is deployed as a Deployment + ClusterIP Service accessible within the kind cluster
The plexd configmap is patched to point api: to the mock-api ClusterIP Service URL
Port-forwarding to mock-api pod is established for assertion validation from the host
GET /test/assertions returns registration_count >= 1 and heartbeat_count >= 1

stories.title: CI engineer gets clear diagnostics when the Kubernetes E2E test fails
stories.want: the test script to print diagnostic information including pod status, events, and logs on failure
stories.so_that: debugging failed E2E runs is possible without SSH access to the CI runner
criteria: On failure, the script outputs kubectl get pods -n plexd-system
On failure, the script outputs kubectl describe daemonset/plexd -n plexd-system
On failure, the script outputs kubectl logs from plexd and mock-api pods
The kind cluster is always deleted on exit regardless of test outcome

stories.title: Developer runs Kubernetes E2E test locally with a single command
stories.want: to run 'make test-e2e-k8s' from the repository root and have the test execute end-to-end
stories.so_that: I can validate Kubernetes manifest changes locally before pushing
criteria: The Makefile target test-e2e-k8s invokes test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh
The script builds both plexd and mock-api Docker images before creating the kind cluster
The script is self-contained with no external dependencies beyond docker, kind, and kubectl
Exit code is 0 on success, non-zero on any failure

stories.title: CI engineer validates CRDs are correctly installed on the kind cluster
stories.want: the E2E test to verify that both PlexdNodeState and PlexdHook CRDs are registered and usable
stories.so_that: CRD schema issues or API group misconfigurations are caught before production
criteria: Both CRD YAML files from deploy/kubernetes/crds/ are applied successfully
kubectl get crd plexdnodestates.plexd.plexsphere.com succeeds
kubectl get crd plexdhooks.plexd.plexsphere.com succeeds
The DaemonSet pod has RBAC permissions to interact with both CRDs

stories.title: Mock API is deployed as a standard Kubernetes workload in the test
stories.want: mock-api Kubernetes manifests (Deployment + ClusterIP Service) that follow standard Kubernetes conventions
stories.so_that: the mock-api is accessible within the cluster and the manifests serve as an example of in-cluster service deployment
criteria: The mock-api Deployment uses the locally-built mockapi:e2e image
The ClusterIP Service routes port 8080 to the mock-api pod
The mock-api pod has a readiness probe on GET /v1/ping
The manifests are stored at test/e2e/kubernetes/mock-api-manifests.yaml

requirements.description: The test script SHALL create a kind cluster, apply all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests, and delete the cluster on exit
requirements.rationale: Core lifecycle management ensures the test is self-contained and does not leak clusters

scenarios.name: Full lifecycle success
scenarios.when: test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh is executed with docker and kind available
scenarios.then: a kind cluster is created, all manifests are applied, assertions pass, and the cluster is deleted
and_then: exit code is 0
no kind cluster remains running after completion

scenarios.name: Cleanup on failure
scenarios.when: any step in the test script fails (e.g., DaemonSet timeout)
scenarios.then: the kind cluster is still deleted via a trap handler
and_then: exit code is non-zero
diagnostic output is printed before cleanup

scenarios.name: Idempotent cluster creation
scenarios.when: a kind cluster with the same name already exists from a previous failed run
scenarios.then: the script deletes the existing cluster before creating a new one
and_then: the test proceeds normally after re-creation

requirements.description: The test script SHALL build and load plexd and mock-api Docker images into the kind cluster
requirements.rationale: Kind requires images to be pre-loaded since it cannot pull from local Docker daemon by default

scenarios.name: Images built and loaded successfully
scenarios.when: the test script runs the build step
scenarios.then: both ghcr.io/plexsphere/plexd:e2e and mockapi:e2e images are built and loaded into kind
and_then: the images are available inside the kind cluster for pod scheduling

scenarios.name: Build failure exits early
scenarios.when: the Docker build for plexd or mock-api fails
scenarios.then: the script exits with a non-zero code before creating the kind cluster
and_then: an error message indicates which build failed

scenarios.name: Image tag matches manifest spec
scenarios.then: the DaemonSet uses image tag :e2e and imagePullPolicy: Never
and_then: kubernetes does not attempt to pull the image from a remote registry

requirements.description: The test script SHALL apply all deploy/kubernetes/ manifests in the correct dependency order
requirements.rationale: Manifests have implicit dependencies: namespace before namespace-scoped resources, CRDs before CRD-using workloads

scenarios.name: Correct application order
scenarios.then: manifests are applied in order: namespace, CRDs, serviceaccount, RBAC, secret, configmap, DaemonSet
and_then: all kubectl apply commands succeed with exit code 0

scenarios.name: CRD registration verified
scenarios.then: kubectl get crd confirms both plexdnodestates and plexdhooks CRDs exist
and_then: the CRDs are usable by the DaemonSet pod

scenarios.name: Secret with test bootstrap token
scenarios.then: a secret named plexd-bootstrap in plexd-system namespace contains a test token
and_then: the DaemonSet pod environment variable PLEXD_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN is populated

requirements.description: The test script SHALL deploy mock-api as a Deployment + ClusterIP Service and configure plexd to use it
requirements.rationale: plexd must connect to the mock API server to exercise registration, heartbeat, and state fetch flows

scenarios.name: Mock-api accessible within cluster
scenarios.then: the mock-api Deployment has 1 ready replica and the ClusterIP Service routes to port 8080
and_then: plexd reaches mock-api at http://mock-api.plexd-system.svc.cluster.local:8080

scenarios.name: Plexd configmap overridden for E2E
scenarios.when: the E2E test creates or patches the configmap
scenarios.then: the config.yaml api field points to mock-api ClusterIP Service
and_then: plexd connects to mock-api instead of the production control plane

scenarios.name: Mock-api readiness gate
scenarios.then: the readiness probe on GET /v1/ping ensures the Service only routes to ready pods
and_then: plexd does not receive connection refused errors from unready mock-api pods

requirements.description: The test script SHALL wait for the DaemonSet to reach ready state with a timeout
requirements.rationale: DaemonSet scheduling on kind is asynchronous; the test must wait for convergence before asserting

scenarios.name: DaemonSet becomes ready within timeout
scenarios.then: kubectl rollout status daemonset/plexd -n plexd-system --timeout=120s succeeds
and_then: at least one plexd pod is in Running state

scenarios.name: Timeout exceeded triggers diagnostics
scenarios.when: the DaemonSet does not reach ready state within 120s
scenarios.then: the script prints diagnostic information and exits non-zero
and_then: the kind cluster is cleaned up

scenarios.name: Pod scheduled on control-plane node
scenarios.when: the kind cluster has one control-plane node
scenarios.then: the plexd pod tolerates all taints and is scheduled on the control-plane node
and_then: desired/ready pod count equals node count

requirements.description: The test script SHALL validate plexd behavior via mock-api /test/assertions counters
requirements.rationale: Assertion counters prove plexd executed its real lifecycle flows against the mock API

scenarios.name: Registration confirmed
scenarios.when: plexd pod starts and registers with mock-api
scenarios.then: GET /test/assertions returns registration_count >= 1
and_then: the test logs the exact counter value

scenarios.name: Heartbeat confirmed
scenarios.when: plexd completes registration and enters heartbeat loop
scenarios.then: GET /test/assertions returns heartbeat_count >= 1
and_then: the test logs the exact counter value

scenarios.name: Polling with retry
scenarios.when: the first poll does not show expected counters (plexd still starting)
scenarios.then: the script retries every 5s up to 60s
and_then: if counters never reach minimums, diagnostic output is printed and test fails

requirements.description: The test script SHALL use kubectl port-forward to access mock-api from the host
requirements.rationale: Kind cluster network is isolated from the host; port-forwarding provides reliable access for assertion queries

scenarios.name: Port-forward established to mock-api
scenarios.then: kubectl port-forward svc/mock-api is started in the background on a local port
and_then: curl http://localhost:<port>/test/assertions returns valid JSON

scenarios.name: Port-forward cleaned up
scenarios.then: the background port-forward process is killed in the cleanup trap
and_then: no orphaned kubectl processes remain

scenarios.name: Port-forward readiness wait
scenarios.then: the script waits briefly and verifies connectivity before proceeding to assertions
and_then: if port-forward fails to establish, the test fails with a clear message

requirements.description: The test script SHALL print diagnostic information on failure
requirements.rationale: CI debugging requires visibility into pod state, events, and logs without manual reproduction

scenarios.name: DaemonSet failure diagnostics
scenarios.when: the DaemonSet does not become ready
scenarios.then: the script outputs: pod list, daemonset describe, pod events, and pod logs
and_then: output is visible in CI job logs

scenarios.name: Assertion failure diagnostics
scenarios.when: assertion counters do not meet minimums
scenarios.then: the script outputs: actual assertion values, plexd pod logs, mock-api pod logs
and_then: the developer can identify the root cause

scenarios.name: Success output is minimal
scenarios.then: only summary lines are printed (e.g., 'PASS: registration_count >= 1')
and_then: exit code is 0

requirements.description: The Makefile SHALL provide a test-e2e-k8s target
requirements.rationale: Consistent Makefile entry point for running E2E tests locally and in CI

scenarios.name: Target invokes test script
scenarios.then: test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh is executed
and_then: exit code is propagated to make

scenarios.name: Target is phony
scenarios.then: test-e2e-k8s is declared in .PHONY
and_then: make always runs the target

scenarios.name: Prerequisite check in script
scenarios.when: docker, kind, or kubectl is missing
scenarios.then: the script exits with a message naming the missing tool
and_then: exit code is non-zero

requirements.description: The mock-api Kubernetes manifests SHOULD follow project labeling conventions
requirements.rationale: Consistent labels enable kubectl queries and align with deploy/kubernetes/ conventions

scenarios.name: Standard labels applied
scenarios.then: all resources have app.kubernetes.io/name and app.kubernetes.io/part-of labels
and_then: labels match the convention used in deploy/kubernetes/

scenarios.name: Resources in plexd-system namespace
scenarios.then: Deployment and Service are in the plexd-system namespace
and_then: mock-api shares the plexd namespace for simple DNS-based discovery

scenarios.name: Resource limits defined
scenarios.then: container has CPU/memory requests and limits
and_then: the mock-api does not starve plexd of resources in the kind cluster

implementation_notes:
Architecture: The test is a self-contained shell script (test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh) that orchestrates a complete kind cluster lifecycle. It builds Docker images for plexd and mock-api, creates a kind cluster, loads the images, applies all production Kubernetes manifests from deploy/kubernetes/, deploys a mock-api Deployment+Service, waits for readiness, then validates plexd's behavior via the /test/assertions endpoint.

Key design decisions:
1. The configmap is created inline by the script (not from deploy/kubernetes/plexd-config-configmap.yaml) because the api URL must point to mock-api ClusterIP instead of the production URL.
2. The DaemonSet manifest from deploy/kubernetes/daemonset.yaml is applied but patched to use the :e2e image tag and imagePullPolicy: Never. This can be done via kubectl patch or sed on the manifest before applying.
3. The bootstrap secret is created via kubectl create secret generic (not the template file which has a placeholder) with a test token value.
4. Port-forwarding is used to query /test/assertions because kind network is isolated. The port-forward targets the mock-api Service.
5. Assertion polling uses a retry loop because plexd takes time to start, register, and begin heartbeating.

Patterns to follow:
- deploy/install_test.sh for shell test conventions (pass/fail output)
- test/e2e/mockapi/ for mock-api Docker image (Dockerfile already exists)
- deploy/kubernetes/ for manifest structure and labeling conventions

Pitfalls:
- The DaemonSet uses hostNetwork: true, which works in kind but requires dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet for DNS resolution to the mock-api ClusterIP Service.
- kind clusters use a single node by default (control-plane), so tolerations must allow scheduling there.
- The plexd container has readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops all capabilities except NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW. Since plexd will fail to actually create WireGuard interfaces in kind (no kernel module), the test focuses on validating the manifest stack and API communication, not WireGuard tunnel creation.
- Port-forward may take a moment to establish; the script should retry the initial connection.
- The mock-api readiness probe prevents premature traffic routing.

Key files:
- deploy/docker/Dockerfile — plexd Docker image build
- test/e2e/mockapi/Dockerfile — mock-api Docker image build
- deploy/kubernetes/*.yaml — all production manifests to apply
- test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi.go — mock API server with /test/assertions endpoint
- Makefile — add test-e2e-k8s target
